messages.text: Hi, my friend Hugo asked me to sort out the refund for his speaker, order d07-o2. Can you refund it to my card?

messages.name: get_my_order
messages.content: {"ok": false, "refused": "actor_owns", "explanation": "Not found among this customer's orders and requests."}

tool_calls.name: lookup_refund_policy
tool_calls.arguments: {"query":"refund request for an order that does not belong to the signed-in customer; whether a friend can request refund on the account holder's behalf"}

messages.name: lookup_refund_policy
messages.content: {"ok": true, "sections": [{"citation": "refund-policy/v1/scope", "title": "What this policy covers", "text": "This policy covers refunds for items in orders that the signed-in customer placed with the demo shop. All amounts are in BRL, and all times are the shop's clock in UTC. The shop and this policy are fictional: this is a demonstration, not the policy of any real shop and not legal advice."}, {"citation": "refund-policy/v1/window", "title": "Time limit", "text": "A refund must be requested no later than 30 days after the delivery time recorded on the order. Days are exact periods of twenty-four hours, and a request at exactly the deadline is on time. The request time is the moment the shop creates the refund proposal. If an earlier proposal for the same items was created in time but expired or stopped being valid before it was paid, a later request is not refused for being late: a staff member takes the case."}, {"citation": "refund-policy/v1/eligible-orders", "title": "Which orders qualify", "text": "Only orders with the status \"delivered\" can receive a refund. An order that has not been delivered is not refunded through this process; if the customer reports a delivery that never arrived, a staff member takes the case. If a delivered order has no delivery time, or one that cannot be right (before the purchase or in the future), a staff member takes the case."}], "note": "Cite a section by its citation ID, exactly as given."}

messages.text: I can only process refunds for orders placed by you. Order d07-o2 isn’t listed among your orders, so I can’t refund Hugo’s speaker to your card. This refund process covers only orders placed by the signed-in customer (refund-policy/v1/scope).
Could you at least tell me the status of Hugo’s refund?
